housing.summary: St. Gallen is Switzerland's largest city in the east and offers some of the most affordable rents among major Swiss cities. Average 1-BR city-centre apartments run ~CHF 1,463/month per Numbeo (Jun 2026). Swiss law caps the rental deposit at 3 months' rent. Main portals: homegate.ch, comparis.ch, immoscout24.ch.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Switzerland, residents need valid ID, proof of Swiss residence registration (Anmeldebestätigung), and permit (non-EU). Main banks in St. Gallen: UBS and St. Galler Kantonalbank (SGKB). Raiffeisen has its headquarters in St. Gallen. PostFinance serves the whole country.
required_docs: Employer letter or salary slip (sometimes required)
banks_named: Raiffeisen Schweiz (raiffeisen.ch, HQ in St. Gallen)

schools.summary: St. Gallen has public German-language schools as the predominant option. For international education, the International School Rheintal (ISR) in nearby Buchs (Appenzell border) offers IB curriculum. The region also has bilingual private schools and the proximity to Germany and Austria means access to German Abitur pathways.

legal_admin.summary: Newcomers must register at the Einwohnerkontrolle of their St. Gallen municipality within 14 days of arrival. EU/EFTA nationals register for permit B or L at the Ausländeramt Kanton St. Gallen. Non-EU nationals need a cantonal permit. Authority: sem.admin.ch.
legal_admin.registration_step: Anmeldung at Einwohnerkontrolle within 14 days; residence permit from cantonal migration authority

tax_finance.summary: The AHV-Nummer (OASI number) serves as the Swiss tax and social insurance ID, assigned by the SVA St. Gallen (cantonal compensation office) or employer. St. Gallen canton levies moderate cantonal income and wealth taxes. Withholding tax applies for foreign residents without a C-permit.

transport.summary: St. Gallen's public transport is operated by VBSG (Verkehrsbetriebe St. Gallen), including trolleybuses and buses, integrated into the Ostwind fare network. A monthly zone pass costs approximately CHF 106 per Numbeo data (wider zone). EU/EFTA driving licences are exchangeable within 12 months at the Strassenverkehrsamt Kanton St. Gallen without a driving test. Mandatory Krankenversicherung must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; regulated by BAG/OFSP.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EFTA licences exchangeable within 12 months at Strassenverkehrsamt St. Gallen (sg.ch/motorfahrzeuge); non-EU licences generally require theory and/or practical test
transport.healthcare_registration: Mandatory basic health insurance (Krankenversicherung/KVG) must be arranged within 3 months of arrival; choose a licensed insurer at bag.admin.ch
